note: The corpus's plain user-defined Verilog function, covering hif-frontend#14 (a function call in a continuous assignment was folded out of the scope that declared the function) and hif-backend#57 (the function's header was emitted without its body). Behavioral rather than structural because #57's output is valid Verilog with the right ports that simply returns nothing, which a round trip cannot see. The body assigns the implicit return variable and then reads it back to clamp, so a lowering that treats the return as a one-shot expression rather than a variable loses the cap without losing the function.
